D5/S3/Quantum/Entanglement/PartialTransp.signature: theorem result (A₁ A₂ : Matrix (Fin m₁) (Fin n₁) ℂ) (B₁ B₂ : Matrix (Fin m₂) (Fin n₂) ℂ) (hA : LinearIndependent ℂ ![A₁, A₂]) (hB : LinearIndependent ℂ ![B₁, B₂]) : (partialTranspose A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂).rank = 2 * (tensorSum A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂).rank ↔ (vRank A₁ A₂ = 2 * hRank A₁ A₂ ∧ vRank B₁ B₂ = 2 * hRank B₁ B₂) ∨ (hRank A₁ A₂ = 2 * vRank A₁ A₂ ∧ hRank B₁ B₂ = 2 * vRank B₁ B₂)
